exchanges: dragon boat practice was brutal tonight
Brutal how? Long session or tough drills?
marisol had us doing sprints for an hour straight my arms r noodles
An hour of sprints would do that. Is a race coming up?
festival in june, she wants us to beat the fire dept team this yr
A rivalry is a good motivator. Have they won before?
3 yrs in a row. marisol used to paddle for mexico at worlds so she takes it personal lol
Having a former international paddler as coach is a real advantage.
we have two kais on the team now its so confusing at the start of practice
Same names on a boat must make calling out commands tricky.
kai nakoa steers and kai brennan is our drummer. we just yell steer kai and drum kai
That's efficient. Do they get along?
they compared tattoos tonight lol. drum kai has a giant octopus on his back
That's a bold choice. Very nautical for a paddling team.
and steer kai has a sea turtle on his calf from when he lived in hawaii. honestly they could start a club
Fitting ink for people who spend their evenings on the water.
bogdan was back too, he missed 2 wks cause of work. hes a mechanic and they had him on overtime
Overtime can wipe out any hobby. Good he's back.
ya we need him hes the strongest paddler we have
Losing your strongest paddler for two weeks would hurt any boat.
aroha brought snacks after, those chocolate fish things from new zealand. shes from rotorua and her mom mails them
That's a nice taste of home to share with the team.
willa couldnt have any tho
Oh no, why not?
she has celiac so she cant have anything with wheat in it, she always brings her own stuff
That's a lot to keep track of. It's good she plans ahead.
ya aroha felt bad so next time shes gonna find gluten free ones
That's thoughtful of her.
precious is our captain she gave a big speech at the end about commitment lol
Sounds like the captain is serious about beating the fire department.
shes a high school principal so she does speeches a lot
Makes sense that she's good at rallying a group.
oh correction bogdans not a mechanic hes a welder. i just remembered he does pipelines
Got it. Overtime on a pipeline sounds exhausting.
ya hes gone for weeks sometimes
That must make it hard to keep up with practice.
my hands r blistered from the paddle any tips
Wear thin gloves for practice, tape the spots that blister, and let them toughen gradually. Try not to pop them.
i popped one already oops
Keep it clean and covered then, and let it dry out between practices.
ok will do
Your hands will toughen up within a few weeks.
marisol said the fire dept team has a new steerer, some guy named rhys who used to be a lifeguard
Sounds like they're gearing up too. A strong steerer makes a big difference.
she thinks steer kai is better tho
Experience on the water counts for a lot.
we'll see in june i guess
It'll be a fun race to watch either way.

questions.message: what tattoo does drum kai have
what did that rhys guy used to do
honestly i just want to see their faces when we win
